summary: Vroom, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting routine amendments to two warehouse credit facilities used by its auto finance subsidiaries. Amendment No. 28 to Warehouse Credit Facility One extends the commitment termination date by one month to July 2, 2026, with no other material changes. Amendment No. 10 to Warehouse Credit Facility Two, effective March 31, 2026, adjusts the advance rate on certain receivables, reduces the minimum tangible net worth covenant, adds undrawn committed availability under a convertible note to available liquidity, and updates undrawn availability under the Mudrick Capital Facility. These are ordinary course financing actions, not a special situation.
